Interest free Special Revolving Fund and Special Imprest were sanctioned to the contract agencies at the time of execution of works, in contravention to the laid down rules. This led to loss of interest to the Department and undue favour to the contract agencies. In execution of Polavaram Hydro-Electric Project (PHEP), the Department extended interest free advances causing loss of interest to be earned. Bank Guarantees (BGs) submitted by contract agency did not cover the entire contract period and were not encashed prior to termination of contract. It is recommended that the State Government should ensure that advances are paid to the contract agencies in line with the existing rules and regulations. Any financial support extended to contract agencies should include a reasonable interest component and backed by supporting BGs for the amount advanced.

Title: DEPARTMENT OF WATER RESOURCES, RIVER DEVELOPMENT & GANGA
URL: https://sansad.in/getFile/lsapps/loksabhaquestions/annex/188/AU3007_dETnz9.pdf
Published: N/A
Author: acer
Highlights:
FUNDING FOR POLAVARAM PHASE-I
...
(a) Government of India has approved funding for Polavaram Irrigation

Project Phase-I (storage up to Elevation Level (EL) +41.15 metres) for

Rs.30,436.95 crore at 2023 Price Level with the balance central grants for the

project limited to Rs.12,157.53 crore. Subsequently, grant of Rs 5,512.40 crore was released for the project in Financial Year 2024-25 and Rs 2810.22 in

Financial Year 2025-26.

(b) The project is on track to achieve the 41.15 metre storage milestone and the critical construction milestones such as construction of the main dam in

Gap-I & Gap-II, Land Acquisition (LA) and Rehabilitation & Resettlement (R&R) works are targeted for completion by June, 2027.

(c) The Central Grant is limited to Phase-I works for water storage up to EL +41.15 m. It covers all civil works of the project up to the Full Reservoir Level (FRL) of EL +45.72 m, LA and R&R works up to EL +41.15 m, and the Left &

Right Main Canals. The cost of the Power House component of the Project is to be borne by the Government of Andhra Pradesh.

(d) The Government of Andhra Pradesh is timely furnishing the necessary technical documents and utilisation certificates as per the requirement.

Polavaram Project Authority under DoWR, RD&GR examines the technical documents and utilisation certificates submitted by Government of Andhra

Pradesh before release of funds.
